newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslav March producer prices up 0.9 pct vs Feb.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslav March producer prices up 0.9 pct vs Feb.

text.p: The Federal Statistics Office reported the following economic indicator details.
YUGOSLAV PRODUCER PRICES MAR 97 FEB 97 MAR 96
NOTES -- March producer prices rose 18.8 percent against the 1996 average, and were 4.8 percent up on December last year.
Cumulative January-March PPI was 31.3 percent up against the same period three-month period last year and 17.4 percent above the average for 1996.
Figures refer to Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, comprising Serbia and Montenegro. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
